scenario.name: ramp-cpu-ort-b4-ext
scenario.description: Task 5.5, ramp-cpu-ort-b4 continued past its top step: ramp-cpu-ort-b4 passed all of 1 to 5 cameras (rated capacity only a lower bound), so this finds the knee. Same stack, worker and settings (yolo11n, ONNX Runtime FP32, infer_batch 4, data-mini at 5 FPS per camera, 1280x720 q85), steps of 5 to 8 cameras (5 repeated as the link to the first run), warmup 20 s, hold 90 s, 3 repetitions, no query load. Start the worker with WORKER_BACKEND=onnxruntime WORKER_INFER_BATCH=4. Quiet host: nothing else CPU-heavy.
